template.name: web_ui_context_window
template.description: SOP for responding through the Web UI HTML window.
template.objective: Keep the model aware that it is replying in a GUI stream with display and timeout limits.

constraints.tool_context: Do not tool call in the main context window. Route tool calls through a separate tool window/context packet and return only compressed evidence to the GUI.

sop: Reply naturally for conversation; do not auto-start jobs.
For tools, route work through separate tool context and stream keepalives.
Summarize evidence back to the GUI without raw tool spam.
If a task is long, estimate duration and schedule/report progress.
template.tool_context_rule: Do not tool call in the main context window. Route tool calls through a separate tool window/context packet and return only compressed evidence to the GUI.

information_hierarchy.output: natural GUI reply plus evidence summary
